name: Exp_BrainTrend2_V2_Duplex
summary: This EA implements the BrainTrend2 V2 Duplex strategy, a dual-direction trend-following system based on the BrainTrend2 indicator. It opens both buy and sell positions based on trend signals, managing each direction independently with separate trailing stops and exit logic.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了BrainTrend2 V2 Duplex策略，是一个基于BrainTrend2指标的双向趋势跟踪系统。它根据趋势信号同时管理买入和卖出仓位，每个方向独立设置追踪止损和出场逻辑。
strategy_analysis: BrainTrend2 V2 Duplex策略基于BrainTrend2指标的趋势信号进行交易，该指标结合了移动平均线和ATR（平均真实波幅）来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为当BrainTrend2指标发出看涨信号时开多仓，发出看跌信号时开空仓，Duplex模式允许同时持有两个方向的仓位。出场条件包括趋势反转信号触发平仓、追踪止损被触及以及固定止损/止盈水平。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数设置，追踪止损功能用于锁定浮盈，但双向同时持仓增加了资金占用和风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: The BrainTrend2 V2 Duplex strategy trades based on trend signals from the BrainTrend2 indicator, which combines moving averages and ATR (Average True Range) to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions open long positions when BrainTrend2 issues a bullish signal and short positions on bearish signals, with Duplex mode allowing simultaneous positions in both directions. Exit conditions include trend reversal signals triggering position closure, trailing stop activation, and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamically calculated lots based on account equity percentage. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameter configuration, with a trailing stop feature to lock in unrealized profits, though simultaneous dual-direction positions increase capital usage and overall risk exposure.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: 双向交易机制可以同时捕捉上涨和下跌趋势，提高市场适应性
基于BrainTrend2指标的趋势判断结合了均线和波动率，信号较为可靠
追踪止损功能有助于锁定盈利，减少回吐风险
参数化设计允许用户灵活调整止损、止盈和追踪止损参数
pros_en: Dual-direction trading mechanism captures both uptrend and downtrend opportunities, improving market adaptability
BrainTrend2 indicator combines moving averages and volatility for relatively reliable trend signals
Trailing stop functionality helps lock in profits and reduces the risk of giving back gains
Parameterized design allows flexible adjustment of stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop settings
cons: Duplex双向同时持仓模式在震荡行情中容易产生双面亏损
默认止损和止盈设为0，缺乏风险保护机制，可能导致大幅亏损
缺乏资金管理和仓位比例控制，仅使用固定手数容易过度交易
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Duplex simultaneous dual-direction positions can produce losses on both sides in ranging markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit set to 0, lacking risk protection and potentially leading to large drawdowns
Lacks money management and proportional position sizing; fixed lots alone can lead to overtrading
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same candle
improvements: 增加资金管理模块，支持基于账户余额比例的动态仓位计算
添加新K线检查和最大持仓数限制，防止重复开仓和过度持仓
增加震荡市过滤机制，在趋势不明确时暂停双向交易
improvements_en: Add a money management module supporting dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage
Implement new bar check and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries and overexposure
Add ranging market filter to pause dual-direction trading when trend is unclear

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，在极端行情中可能遭受重大亏损
Duplex双向持仓模式在震荡市中可能同时亏损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit of 0 may result in significant losses during extreme market moves
Duplex dual-direction positions can lose on both sides in choppy/ranging markets
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position openings on the same signal

summary_en: This EA implements the BrainTrend2 V2 Duplex strategy, a dual-direction trend-following system based on the BrainTrend2 indicator. It opens both buy and sell positions based on trend signals, managing each direction independently with separate trailing stops and exit logic.
